```yaml
name: Gemini Code Review

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Fetch base branch
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }}
        run: |
          git fetch origin "$BASE_REF:refs/remotes/origin/$BASE_REF"

      - name: Get diff
        id: diff
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }}
        run: |
          diff=$(git diff "origin/$BASE_REF...HEAD")
          echo "diff=$diff" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Install jq
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Call Gemini API
        id: gemini
        env:
          GEMINI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GEMINI_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          escaped_diff=$(printf '%s' "${{ steps.diff.outputs.diff }}" | jq -R .)
          response=$(curl -s -X POST "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-2.5-flash:generateContent?key=${GEMINI_API_KEY}" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d '{
              "contents": [
                {
                  "parts": [
                    {
                      "text": '"$escaped_diff"'
                    }
                  ]
                }
              ],
              "generationConfig": {
                "temperature": 0.2,
                "topK": 64,
                "topP": 0.95,
                "maxOutputTokens": 2048
              }
            }')
          echo "response=$response" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Parse Gemini response
        id: parse
        run: |
          text=$(echo '${{ steps.gemini.outputs.response }}' | jq -r '.candidates[0].content.parts[0].text')
          echo "review_text=$text" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create review
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        env:
          REVIEW_TEXT: ${{ steps.parse.outputs.review_text }}
        with:
          script: |
            const reviewText = process.env.REVIEW_TEXT;
            if (!reviewText || reviewText.trim() === '') {
              core.info('No review text generated.');
              return;
            }
            await github.rest.pulls.createReview({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              pull_number: context.issue.number,
              body: reviewText,
              event: 'COMMENT'
            });
```
